title: Dutch and Austrian Embassies Are Damaged as Russian Drones Swarm Kyiv
summary: Foreign ministers for Austria and the Netherlands said no one was harmed at their embassy compounds, and the European Union’s ambassador said a drone “exploded right above my head" by her hotel.
